title: Thai red curry with tofu & veg (+ chicken, optional)
desc: A quick blender red curry paste, cream and stock, peppers and green beans with crispy tofu for both; the chicken cooked in a ladle of the sauce. The rice, the cauliflower rice.
trouble: More cream and a squeeze of lime.
More lime and a splash of soy sauce.
It boiled hard — keep it at a gentle simmer; whisk to bring it back.
ing: stalks for the paste, leaves to serve

steps.t: Paste: blend the chilli flakes, shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, coriander stalks, cumin, coriander seed, smoked paprika, lime zest and soy sauce with 2 tbsp water to a paste.
steps.w: Fresh paste has more aroma than a jar and contains no sugar or shrimp paste, so the other portion stays vegetarian.
steps.c: Thick, brick-red paste, no big lemongrass bits.
steps.m: Blending dry — add water a spoon at a time so it turns.
steps.img: red curry paste in a blender jug

steps.t: Start the rice. Pan-fry the tofu in the oil on high until golden on two sides; set aside.
steps.w: Dry, hot tofu browns and holds its shape in the sauce.
steps.m: Wet tofu — press it in a towel first or it steams and sticks.
steps.img: golden tofu cubes in a pan

steps.t: Fry the paste in the same pan 2 minutes, stirring, then add the cream and stock; bring to a gentle simmer.
steps.w: Frying the paste first releases its oils; cream can split if it boils hard.
steps.c: Fragrant, red oil on the surface, gentle bubbles.
steps.img: curry paste fried then cream added

steps.t: Add the pepper and green beans; simmer 5 minutes. simmer that chicken in a ladle of the sauce in a small pan 8–10 minutes.
steps.w: Separate pan keeps the other portion meat-free.
steps.img: red curry with peppers and green beans simmering

steps.t: Return the tofu, squeeze in lime juice, taste and add soy if needed. Fry the cauliflower rice 4 minutes. Serve with coriander leaves.
steps.w: Lime at the end keeps it bright.
steps.img: bowl of thai red curry with tofu and coriander

title: Thai green curry with green beans & tofu (+ chicken, optional)
desc: Green chilli, coriander and basil paste, cream and stock, green beans, broccoli and tofu; the chicken breast strips simmered in the own ladle of sauce.
reheat: Gently, until piping hot all through.
trouble: More cream and a squeeze of lime.
More lime and a splash of soy sauce.
It boiled hard — keep it at a gentle simmer; whisk to bring it back.

steps.t: Paste: blend green chillies, coriander, basil, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, shallot, cumin, lime zest and soy sauce with 3 tbsp water.
steps.w: Fresh herbs give the green colour; blending briefly keeps it bright.
steps.m: Blending for minutes — it heats and turns dull.
steps.img: bright green curry paste in a blender

steps.t: Start the rice. Brown the tofu in the oil; set aside. Fry 3 tbsp of the paste 1 minute, add cream and stock.
steps.w: Fry the paste briefly — green paste burns faster than red.
steps.img: green curry sauce in a pan

steps.t: Put the thin chicken breast strips into the own small pan with a ladle of sauce and simmer gently 6–8 minutes. Meanwhile simmer the green beans in the main pan 2 minutes, then add the broccoli for 4–5 minutes more; add the tofu back.
steps.w: Thin strips cook through in the sauce without drying out; the own pan keeps the curry vegetarian.
steps.m: Boiling the chicken hard — it toughens and the cream splits.
steps.img: green curry with green beans broccoli and tofu, small pan of chicken strips in green sauce

steps.t: Finish with lime juice and basil leaves; the cauliflower rice on the side.
steps.img: bowl of thai green curry with basil

title: Massaman curry with tofu & potato (+ chicken, optional)
desc: The mild, warm-spiced Thai curry: cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, peanuts and cream; potatoes, cauliflower, chicken in the own pan.
trouble: More cream and a squeeze of lime.
More lime and a splash of soy sauce.
It boiled hard — keep it at a gentle simmer; whisk to bring it back.

steps.t: Paste: blend shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, cumin, coriander seed, chilli and soy sauce with 2 tbsp water.
steps.w: Warm spices make massaman mild and fragrant rather than hot.
steps.img: massaman curry paste in a blender

steps.t: Boil the potato cubes 8 minutes; steam the cauliflower florets alongside. Brown the tofu in the oil; set aside.
steps.w: Par-cooking means everything is tender at the same time.
steps.img: potato cubes and cauliflower boiling, tofu browning

steps.t: Fry the paste 2 minutes, add cream and stock, simmer 5 minutes. chicken in a small pan with a ladle of sauce 10 minutes, with the cauliflower.
steps.img: massaman curry simmering in two pans

steps.t: Add the potato and tofu to the main pan, finish with lime juice and the peanuts.
steps.w: Peanuts at the end stay crunchy.
steps.img: massaman curry with potatoes tofu and peanuts
